master_script.hook: Kya aapki clinic raat ke eleven baje ke messages ka jawab deti hai?

hooks.text: Kya aapki clinic raat 11 baje ke messages ka jawab deti hai…
Raat 11 baje clinic ko message aata hai, subah tak reply nahi aata…
Clinic par raat 11 baje WhatsApp sawal aata hai, lekin reply nahi hota.
Bohot kam clinic raat ke messages ka jawab dete hain…
Kabhi dhyan diya hai, raat ko aaye clinic messages ka kya hota hai…
Kaash mujhe clinic ke raat ke messages ke liye ye pehle pata hota…

master_script.linkedin_english: If you run a clinic, a customer may message you on WhatsApp at 11 p.m. and get no reply until morning. I build AI chatbots that answer common questions and save every enquiry on WhatsApp, your website, and DMs. Comment BOT and I will send you a one-page checklist with ten questions a WhatsApp reply bot should answer, so you can see if it fits your clinic.

facts.claim: Inbound customer messages on WhatsApp Business do not cost the business; every message a customer sends is free.
facts.title: WhatsApp Business Cost per Message in India: 2026 Rates

facts.claim: WhatsApp Business only charges for messages that are successfully delivered; if a template message fails to reach the phone, it is not billed.
facts.title: WhatsApp Business Cost per Message in India: 2026 Rates

facts.claim: When a customer sends a WhatsApp message, a 24‑hour service window opens and resets each time the customer sends a new message.
facts.title: WhatsApp Business Cost per Message in India: 2026 Rates

facts.claim: A message sent via WhatsApp, a marketplace, or social media may appear in that platform even though no email alert is generated for the business.
facts.title: Why Are Customer Enquiries Missing from My Inbox? - Anagata IT Solutions

facts.claim: Missing enquiries can result from website forms rejecting submissions, saving records without sending email, sending notifications to outdated addresses, or routing them to filtered folders.
facts.title: Why Are Customer Enquiries Missing from My Inbox? - Anagata IT Solutions

facts.claim: When the source of a customer enquiry cannot be identified, it should be labeled as "unknown" rather than forcing it into a specific campaign category.
